introduce: Sit on the floor with your knees bent, feet lifted a little bit and back tilted backwards.\n\nThen hold your hands together and twist from side to side.
name: RUSSIAN TWIST

tips.text: We suggest that you do this on a mat.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Keep your legs still.
Tighten your abs.
Don't move your legs when twisting.
Breathe naturally.
To get more of a challenge, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
If you feel it's too hard, put your feet on the floor.
You should feel your abdominals burning, maybe even shivering.
This primarily targets your obliques.

introduce: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Put your arms flat at your sides. \n\nThen lift your butt up and down.
name: BUTT BRIDGE

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Keep your feet around shoulder width apart.
Exhale when lifting your butt, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise really works on your glutes.
This exercise strengthens your lower back.

introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. \n\nThen lift your right leg to the side at a 90 degree angle.
name: FIRE HYDRANT RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.
Keep your arms straight.
Keep your lifted leg at a 90 degree angle.
Always keep your core tight.
Don't arch your back.
Don't lift your leg higher than your torso.
Lift your leg as you exhale and lower it as you inhale.
If it's too easy for you, hold your leg up for several seconds.
You should feel your butt burning.
This exercise tones and firms up your butt and thighs.
This exercise can strengthen your hips and tighten your core.

introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. \n\nThen lift your left leg to the side at a 90 degree angle.
name: FIRE HYDRANT LEFT

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.
Keep your arms straight.
Keep your lifted leg at a 90 degree angle.
Always keep your core tight.
Don't arch your back.
Don't lift your leg higher than your torso.
Lift your leg as you exhale and lower it as you inhale.
If it's too easy for you, hold your leg up for several seconds.
You should feel your butt burning.
This exercise tones and firms up your butt and thighs.
This exercise can strengthen your hips and tighten your core.

introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your hands on your hips. \n\nStep a big step backward with your right leg and lower your body until your left thigh is parallel to the floor. Return and repeat with the other side.
name: BACKWARD LUNGE

tips.text: Take a big step backward.
Keep your legs at a 90 degree angle.
Keep your weight on your heels when pushing your body up.
Don't let your front knee go past your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
To increase the difficulty, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
Your knees should not be sore.
This targets all your leg muscles.
It\'s a good leg exercise that won\'t hurt your knees.

introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands directly under your shoulders. 

Then take a breath in and make your belly fall down, shoulders roll back and head come up towards the ceiling. 

As you exhale, round your spine toward the ceiling and draw your navel up towards your spine, and drop your head.

Repeat the exercise, matching the movement to your breath.
name: CAT COW POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure your palms are directly under your shoulders.
Please make sure your knees are directly under your hips.
Inhale as your belly falls down, and exhale as your belly curves in.
This exercise works on your spine, back and abs.

introduce:
Place your right hand on the left side of your head.

Exhale, gently pull your head towards the right.

Hold for a few seconds, breathing naturally.
name: SIDE NECK STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please always keep your left shoulder flat.
Please pull your head gently.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Place your left hand on the right side of your head.

Exhale, gently pull your head towards the left.

Hold for a few seconds, breathing naturally.
name: SIDE NECK STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please always keep your right shoulder flat.
Please pull your head gently.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. 

Inhale, lift your left arm overhead, and put your right hand on the floor for support. Exhale slowly, bend your upper body to the right, gently bending your right arm. 

Hold the side bend. Breathe deeply into your left rib cage to help deepen the stretch.
name: SEATED SIDE BEND RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the left side of your body.
Inhale to expand through the ribs, exhale to deepen the side stretch.

introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. 

Inhale, lift your right arm overhead, and put your left hand on the floor for support. Exhale slowly, bend your upper body to the left, gently bending your left arm. 

Hold the side bend. Breathe deeply into your right rib cage to help deepen the stretch.
name: SEATED SIDE BEND LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the right side of your body.
Inhale to expand through the ribs, exhale to deepen the side stretch.

introduce: Start in the straight arm plank position with your hands under your shoulders and feet together.\n\nHop your feet apart and land on your toes, then hop back. Repeat the exercise.
name: PLANK JACKS

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your upper body stable.
Your body should be in a straight line.
Don't sink or raise your hips.
Exhale through your mouth as you jump your feet out.
Inhale through your nose as you jump your feet back in.
It is a good exercise for your abs, core, shoulders, and lower back.

introduce:
Start on all fours, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.

Inhale, bring your left knee forward, and place your left knee behind your left wrist on the ground. Exhale, slide your right leg back, extending it straight behind you.

Put your forearms on the ground in front of your leg. 

Hold for a few seconds. Inhale to lengthen your spine forward. Exhale, release tension in your left hip.
name: PIGEON POSE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Your front knee should be in line with the outside of your shoulder.
You should not feel any discomfort.
This exercise helps to make your muscle groups more flexible.
This exercise helps to reduce sciatic pain.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to soften your left hip to open.

introduce:
Start on all fours, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.

Inhale, bring your right knee forward, and place your right knee behind your right wrist on the ground. Exhale, slide your left leg back, extending it straight behind you.

Put your forearms on the ground in front of your leg. 

Hold for a few seconds. Inhale to lengthen your spine forward. Exhale, release tension in your right hip.
name: PIGEON POSE RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Your front knee should be in line with the outside of your shoulder.
You should not feel any discomfort.
This exercise helps to make your muscle groups more flexible.
This exercise helps to reduce sciatic pain.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to soften your right hip to open.

introduce:
Sit on the floor with legs extended. Put your hands directly under your shoulders with your fingers pointing toward your hips. 

Lift your hips off the floor. Keep your body straight. Hold this position.

Don't hold your breath. Breathe normally from your abdomen instead of your chest.
name: REVERSE PLANK

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Please tighten your core.
Breathe naturally.
Don't sink your hips.
Please put your hands directly under your shoulders.
This exercise helps burn your back fat, tighten your core and improve your posture.

introduce: Sit down with your hands behind you on the ground, your legs extended and your upper body leaning backward. \n\nBend your knees, and bring them toward your chest; then fully extend your legs without touching the ground. Repeat the exercise.
name: LEG IN & OUTS

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Please keep your core tight.
Please keep your back straight.
Please do it slowly to feel the squeezing.
Exhale when bringing your knees to your chest, and inhale when extending your legs.
Please don\'t touch the ground when you extend your leg.

introduce:
Start in a side plank position with your right forearm on the floor and your left hand behind your ear. 

Then squeeze your abs, and bend your left knee. Bring your left elbow and left knee close to each other. 

Go back to the start position, and repeat the exercise.
name: SIDE PLANK KNEE CRUNCH LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your hips off the floor.
Keep your abs tight.
Put your supporting elbow directly under your shoulders.
Exhale when you lift your knee and inhale when you lower it.
You should feel your abs burning.
This exercise works on your core and your thighs.

introduce:
Start in a side plank position with your left forearm on the floor and your right hand behind your ear. 

Then squeeze your abs, and bend your right knee. Bring your right elbow and right knee close to each other.  

Go back to the start position, and repeat the exercise.
name: SIDE PLANK KNEE CRUNCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your hips off the floor.
Keep your abs tight.
Put your supporting elbow directly under your shoulders.
Exhale when you lift your knee and inhale when you lower it.
You should feel your abs burning.
This exercise works on your core and your thighs.

introduce:
Sit upright on the floor. Bend your left leg with your heel close to your sit bone. Extend your right leg forward. Put your left hand on the floor behind you for support. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, twist your upper body to the left. Bend your right elbow and hook it on the outside of your left knee, fingers pointing upward. Turn your gaze over your left shoulder.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine. With each exhale, gently rotate your body deeper into the twist.
name: SAGE MARICHI'S POSE Ⅲ LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Keep your legs still when twisting your body.
Twist from your waist instead of your chest.
Evenly distribute your weight between both sit bones.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to deepen the twist.
If sitting upright is challenging, place a block under your buttocks.
This exercise stretches your shoulders, chest, and spine.
This exercise helps relieve your back and hip pain.

introduce:
Sit upright on the floor. Bend your right leg with your heel close to your sit bone. Extend your left leg forward. Put your right hand on the floor behind you for support. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, twist your upper body to the right. Bend your left elbow and hook it on the outside of your right knee, fingers pointing upward. Turn your gaze over your right shoulder.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine. With each exhale, gently rotate your body deeper into the twist.
name: SAGE MARICHI'S POSE Ⅲ RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Keep your legs still when twisting your body.
Twist from your waist instead of your chest.
Evenly distribute your weight between both sit bones.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to deepen the twist.
If sitting upright is challenging, place a block under your buttocks.
This exercise stretches your shoulders, chest, and spine.
This exercise helps relieve your back and hip pain.

introduce:
Lie on a mat with your arms extended by your sides and your legs extended straight up toward the ceiling.

Draw your navel in toward your spine. Slowly lower your legs to one side.

Engage your core and lift your legs back up, rotating them in an arc to the opposite side and back down to the starting position.

Repeat on the other side.
name: CORKSCREW

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and down on the mat.
Please inhale as you prepare and exhale as you twist or rotate your legs.
Breathe consistently and avoid holding your breath.
This exercise helps strengthen and stabilize the core.

introduce:
Lie flat on a mat, extend your legs at an angle from the mat. Engage your core, lift your shoulders off the mat with arms straight by your ears, shoulder-width apart. Inhale to prepare.

Exhale, bend your knees towards your chest as you sweep your arms out to the sides, reaching around to grasp your shins or ankles and squeeze.

Inhale, reach your arms over your head and keep your legs long.

Repeat the exercise.
name: DOUBLE LEG STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your shoulders lifted.
Please keep your core engaged.
This exercise can stabilize your core muscles.
This exercise helps with your abdominal strength.
Exhale as you bend your knees towards your chest.
Inhale as you extend your arms overhead and keep your legs long.

introduce:
Sit straight on a mat with your right knee bent to the left side and your right foot behind you. Put your left foot against your right thigh. 

Keep your hips grounded. Place your hands on the floor for support.

Engage your abs to bring your torso back to the sitting position. Then lift your left arm and curve your body to the right side.

Repeat the exercise.
name: MERMAID LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
Breathe naturally.
Please do not lift your shoulder as you curve.
This exercise stretches your obliques, shoulders, and inner thighs.

introduce:
Sit straight on a mat with your left knee bent to the right side and your left foot behind you. Put your right foot against your left thigh. 

Keep your hips grounded. Place your hands on the floor for support.

Engage your abs to bring your torso back to the sitting position. Then lift your right arm and curve your body to the left side.

Repeat the exercise.
name: MERMAID RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please put your left hand on the floor for some support.
Please keep your back straight.
Breathe naturally.
Please do not lift your shoulder as you curve.
Please let your right arm as close as much to your ear as you curve.
This exercise stretches your obliques, shoulders, and inner thighs.

introduce:
Start in a side plank with your body in a straight line and support yourself on your right forearm.

Engage your core and lift your left leg up and down.

Repeat the exercise.
name: SIDE PLANK LEG LIFT LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your left leg straight.
Please make sure your shoulders are stable.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Start in a side plank with your body in a straight line and support yourself on your left forearm.

Engage your core and lift your right leg up and down.

Repeat the exercise.
name: SIDE PLANK LEG LIFT RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your right leg straight.
Please make sure your right arm is straight and your shoulders are stable.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Lie flat on your back. Engage your core, curl your head and shoulders off the mat and bring both knees into your chest.

Extend your left leg out straight. Hold onto your bent leg, with your outside hand on your knee and your inside hand on your ankle.

Switch legs, bending the left leg and extending your right leg. Repeat the exercise, alternating sides.
name: SINGLE LEG STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please use your abs to do the move instead of pulling your legs.
Please keep your shoulders lifted.
Please keep a neutral spine position.
The exercise challenges the deep abdominal muscles.
Keep breathing steadily.
Use each exhale to deepen the stretch and each inhale to engage your core.
